key_insight: Quantum Broker distributes a circuit’s measurement shots across heterogeneous QPUs to meet user-defined cost, latency, and fidelity requirements.
engineering_relevance: Its provider-agnostic execution layer helps engineers manage backend selection and shot allocation across fragmented quantum cloud platforms.
method: Express QoS constraints and objectives declaratively with QQSpec.
Plan shot allocations with MILP or nonlinear dual annealing.
evidence_signal: Benchmark-circuit experiments on noisy simulators show feasible QoS-aware plans and improved QoS satisfaction over single-backend and naive multi-backend baselines.
watch_item: Higher-quality nonlinear allocations require more planning time, and the abstract reports simulator-based rather than real-QPU validation.
paper_title: Quantum Broker: QoS-Aware Distribution of Quantum Computations
